strings.JNR_WYLDER_PASSIVE0_DESCRIPTION: After Sprinting for 2 seconds, gain a 25% bonus to your sprint speed, calculated after all other buffs.
strings.JNR_WYLDER_PASSIVE1_DESCRIPTION: <style=cIsUtility>Once Per Run.</style> Automatically <style=cIsUtility>dodge</style> a lethal attack. Upon activation, you gain 3 seconds of <style=cIsDamage>invincibility</style>, and you are <style=cIsUtility>cleansed</style> of all debuffs.
strings.JNR_WYLDER_PRIMARY_DESCRIPTION: Swing your greatsword for <style=cIsDamage>300% damage.</style> Holding the skill button will charge a <style=cIsUtility>Heavy Attack,</style> dealing <style=cIsDamage>800% damage</style>.
strings.JNR_WYLDER_SECONDARY_DESCRIPTION: Perform the <style=cIsUtility>Weapon Skill</style> on your equipped greatsword. Effect varies based on selected weapon.
strings.JNR_WYLDER_UTILITY_DESCRIPTION: Fire your Claw Shot for <style=cIsDamage>100% Damage</style> and pull yourself towards it.  Activating the Primary Skill button during the pull performs a sweep for <style=cIsDamage>500% damage</style>, <style=cIsDamage>igniting</style> your sword for 10 seconds.
strings.JNR_WYLDER_SPECIAL_DESCRIPTION: Charge up a spike, gaining <style=cIsUtility>Immovable</style> and <style=cIsUtility>50% + 100 Armor</style>. After charging, lunge forward with a massive explosion dealing <style=cIsDamage>1000% damage</style> and stunning enemies hit for 3 seconds.
